releaseNotes: Adds received friend reaction totals on the You screen, open-ended Start Rest timer controls with pause/resume/reset and 30-second markers, manual workout elapsed-time controls, exercise-specific notes, and exercise name/description editing with optional forward plan updates. Only exercise logging advances the workout clock after it starts; body metrics and later warm-up changes do not alter it. Also includes the v1.9.2 recovery and plan-import fixes.
